name: staleness-ignores-code-that-is-not-in-the-app
find: "postroll",                  // the generation pipeline, run from the checkout
replace: // the pipeline is deliberately not excluded
breaks: a week of Python only commits makes the running app read as out of date, and the remedy the warning names cannot clear it: the pipeline is read live off the checkout, so rebuilding produces a new build and the same verdict at the next launch. That is how a warning becomes something to dismiss on reflex, taking the real one with it (#691, L36, L144)
